name: meter_check
description: Scan verse for meter. Spanish: metric syllables with synalepha between words and the final-word rule (+1 aguda, −1 esdrújula), fitted to octosílabo, endecasílabo (with its accent types: heroico, melódico, sáfico, enfático, dactílico, mixto, yámbico) or alejandrino in two hemistichs of 7, choosing where a hiatus is needed and showing the scansion. English: an iambic pentameter heuristic.

lines.description: Several lines, scanned one by one

meter.description: es default auto (the count with every synalepha); en only iambic_pentameter

syllables.description: es: any target count instead of meter

input.line: Escrito está en mi alma vuestro gesto

catalog.source: original; syllables by the RAE orthographic rules (Ortografía 2010, DPD 'tilde', 'diptongo', 'hiato'); synalepha and the final-word rule of Spanish metrics; endecasílabo types as defined in es.wikipedia 'Endecasílabo' (Ritmos y acentos, revision of 31 Dec 2025)
